sentences: G: I’m taking pictures of birds.
B: Are you interested in taking pictures?
I want to be a photographer.
G: This pizza is so good.
G: So, do you want to be a chef in the future?

items.statement_ko: 남자아이가 먼저 여자아이에게 무엇을 하고 있는지 물었다.
items.why_ko: 첫 문장에서 남자아이가 "What are you doing?"이라고 묻는다.
items.statement_en: The boy was the first one to ask the girl what she was doing.

items.why_ko: 여자아이가 "I'm taking pictures of birds."라고 답한다.
_evidence_text: G: I’m taking pictures of birds.
items.statement_en: The girl was taking photos of birds.

items.statement_ko: 여자아이가 남자아이에게 사진 찍기에 관심이 있는지 물었다.
items.why_ko: 사진 찍기에 관심이 있는지 물은 사람은 남자아이다.
_evidence_text: B: Are you interested in taking pictures?
items.statement_en: The girl asked the boy if he was interested in taking pictures.

items.statement_ko: 여자아이는 사진 찍기에 관심이 별로 없다고 답했다.
items.why_ko: 여자아이는 "Yes, a lot."이라며 관심이 매우 많다고 답했다.
items.statement_en: The girl answered that she was not very interested in taking pictures.

items.why_ko: "I want to be a photographer."라고 말한다.
_evidence_text: I want to be a photographer.
items.statement_en: The girl's dream job is to be a photographer.

_evidence_text: G: This pizza is so good.
items.statement_en: The girl said that the pizza tasted very good.

items.statement_ko: 여자아이는 Tom에게 그 피자를 직접 만들었는지 물었다.
items.statement_en: The girl asked Tom whether he had made the pizza himself.

items.statement_ko: Tom은 그 피자를 자신이 만든 것이 아니라고 답했다.
items.why_ko: Tom은 "Yes, I did."라며 자신이 만들었다고 답했다.
items.statement_en: Tom answered that he was not the one who made the pizza.

items.statement_ko: Tom은 요리에 정말 관심이 많다고 말했다.
items.statement_en: Tom said he has a strong interest in cooking.

items.statement_ko: 남자아이가 여자아이에게 장래에 요리사가 되고 싶은지 물었다.
items.why_ko: 요리사가 되고 싶은지 물은 사람은 여자아이이고, 질문을 받은 사람은 남자아이다.
_evidence_text: G: So, do you want to be a chef in the future?
items.statement_en: The boy asked the girl if she wanted to become a chef in the future.

items.statement_ko: Tom은 요리사가 되는 것이 자신의 꿈은 아니라고 말했다.
items.why_ko: Tom은 "Yes, that's my dream."이라며 요리사가 꿈이라고 말했다.
items.statement_en: Tom said that becoming a chef was not his dream.
